title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-23
lineage: DAT > TASCAM DA-20 (spdif out) -> Apogee Wide Eye spdif innterconnect -> Lynx Two Soundcard (spdif in) -> Wavelab 6.0
taper: DAT from the collection of Todd Evans
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Exceptional early‑70s soundboard capture with a smoking China Cat → The Other One transition.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the astonishingly clear and modern‑sounding audio, calling it possibly the best early‑70s recording available. The show is highlighted for an unforgettable China Cat Sunflower → Rider (The Other One) segue that makes this performance one of their favorites from ’71.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and unanimous praise for both the audio fidelity and a standout song transition indicate an outstanding recording and show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crystal‑clear, almost as good as modern releases; no issues or artifacts mentioned.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on overall set structure, but the praised China Cat → Rider segue suggests a strong flow.
